sources.entry: Vinyl Cache - Web application accelerator/caching HTTP reverse proxy (formerly Varnish). (Source Code) BSD-2-Clause Go/deb/Docker

summary.name: Vinyl Cache
summary.one_liner: Vinyl Cache is an HTTP reverse proxy and web application accelerator (caching), formerly known as Varnish.
use_cases: accelerate a web application with HTTP caching
run a caching reverse proxy in front of a backend server
build or maintain vinyl cache modules
summary.what_it_does: The page is the source code repository for Vinyl Cache, showing recent commits, directory listing, and build files such as configure.ac, INSTALL and LICENSE. It is described in the awesome-selfhosted listing as a web application accelerator and caching HTTP reverse proxy, formerly called Varnish. The repository includes VCL-related sources, vmod modules, documentation and man pages, and a vtest-based test setup. The visible commit messages cover bug fixes such as an objcore leak in vcl_synth.
notable: Successor to Varnish, renamed Vinyl Cache
Configured with VCL (Varnish Configuration Language style) and vmod modules
caveats: Page text shows only the repository file listing and recent commits; no feature documentation or pricing beyond the license
